copy.title: South Coast Landscapes — Landscaping, Retaining Walls & Turf, Illawarra
copy.description: Family-run landscapers based in Dapto. Retaining walls, excavation and drainage, driveways, paving, pool surrounds, decking, turf and SMART irrigation across the Illawarra. Front and back yards, finished start to finish.
copy.headline:
From mounds
of dirt to a
finished yard.
copy.sub: Retaining wall, drainage, driveway, paving, turf, planting and irrigation — front and back, by one crew. Most of our work starts where the builder stopped.
copy.statementBody: A landscaping job takes over your driveway, your side gate and your weekends. Ours ends each day with the site swept and the gear stacked, because you still have to live there while we build it. It is the thing customers mention that we never put in a quote.
copy.servicesHeadline:
Design it, build it,
keep it alive.
copy.servicesIntro: Design, construction, maintenance and irrigation sit in the same business. The crew that draws it builds it, plants it and sets the watering — nothing is handed to a stranger halfway through.
copy.apertureLine: Wall. Driveway. Turf. Water. In one go.
copy.workIntro: Six jobs across Dapto, Port Kembla, Flinders, Figtree and Thirroul. Every one designed, built and planted by the same crew.
copy.processIntro: Our own process, in our own order. You see a concept and a written quote before any detailed design is charged for, and you approve both before a machine comes near the block.
copy.reviewsIntro: Straight off their Google profile, word for word. Four of the six name Ryan.
copy.recognitionIntro: Two things you can check before you book anyone: that they hold a licence, and that a real supplier stands behind their work.
copy.areasIntro: Based in Dapto. Most jobs sit within twenty minutes of it, and the portfolio runs from Kiama in the south to Engadine in the north.
copy.enquireIntro: The first consultation costs nothing. Tell us the suburb, what the yard is doing now and what you want out of it, and Ryan will come and take a look.

owner.body: Founder of South Coast Landscapes, and the person who quotes the work. Four reviewers across five years name him rather than the company — Ryan and the team, Ryan and his team — which is the short version of what a family-run business actually means.
owner.team: Behind him is a crew of qualified tradesmen and a horticulturist. Reviewers call them polite, hard-working and extremely punctual, and one made a point of the way they cleaned up the site at the end of each work day.

credentials.label: Fully licensed landscaper
credentials.body: Licensed for the construction work as well as the planting — retaining, drainage, concreting and paving are all done in-house rather than subcontracted out.

credentials.label: Reece Irrigation preferred supplier
credentials.body: The irrigation is designed and fitted by us, not left to whoever turns up with a trencher. That includes SMART controllers such as SkyDrop.

priceLines._comment: No price is published anywhere on their site and none is invented here. The sentences that would carry a number stay hidden. Ask Ryan, then fill in e.g. fee: "$0 — the first consultation is free", build: "$25,000 and $90,000".

process.detail: Ryan comes to the property, walks the block with you and works out what the yard has to do — for the kids, the dog, the entertaining, the mower. No charge for the visit.
A concept for the space and a written quote against it, scoped to the job rather than a rate card. You see the number here, before any detailed design is charged for.
The concept drawn up properly — levels, retaining, drainage, materials, planting and where the water runs. Adjusted until you are happy with it.
The build, in the order the site needs it: excavation and drainage, retaining, concrete and paving, decking, turf, planting, irrigation. Site swept at the end of every day.
We walk the finished yard with you, then the last thing off site is our gear. It goes back to being a home, not a job.

faq.q: Our house is a new build and the yard is still dirt. Can you start from that?
faq.a: That is most of what we do. Mounds of dirt, a mud pit, a bare graded slope — front, back and down the side. We take it from there through excavation and drainage, retaining, driveway, paving, turf, planting and irrigation, and hand back a yard you can use.

It is the job that comes up most in our reviews. Reinforced Besser Block faced in sandstone stackstone, charcoal and curved Tasman Block, rendered, concrete sleeper and timber. Excavation and drainage go in with it, because an undrained wall is a wall that moves.

faq.q: What does a landscaping job cost?
faq.a:
There is no price list, and nobody who has not stood on your block should give you one. The first consultation is free: we walk the site, set out the scope, and you get a written quote against a concept before any detailed design is charged for. Design fees start from .

One customer's summary of how that held up: “Timelines and budgets were accurate.” Most builds of this kind land between , though that depends entirely on scope.

faq.q: Will the site be a mess while you are here?
faq.a: You still have to live there, so no. The crew clean up the site at the end of each work day and stack the gear. That is a customer's line about us, not ours about ourselves.

faq.q: Can the irrigation be run from my phone?
faq.a: Yes. We are a Reece Irrigation preferred supplier and fit SMART systems — SkyDrop among them — that connect to your home wifi, so the watering is set from the lounge rather than from the tap. Automatic systems and driplines as well, sized to the planting.

faq.q: Do you look after it afterwards?
faq.a: If you want us to. Mowing, weeding and pruning, mulching, fertilising and aeration, rubbish removal — done by the crew who built it and know what was planted where and what the irrigation is set to.
